newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks slip, Olainfarm again in focus.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks slip, Olainfarm again in focus.

text.p: Latvian share trade slid lower on Friday, with drugs firm Olainfarm again standing out with high trade and a volatile price.
Turnover slipped to 70,000 lats versus Thursday's 112,000 lats and the Rietumu index lost 1.71 percent to 152.12, a fall of 3.85 percent during the week.
Brokers said the market was likely to stay around current levels in the following week.
They highlighted Olainfarm as again the most notable stock today as it slid to 2.09 lats from 2.40 lats on by far the highest trade of 42,600 lats.
Brokers differed over prospects for the stock after it joined the market on Monday. It has swung between 2.49 and 2.09 lats over the week.
Many brokers had expected a price of around 1.5 to 1.90 lats after it reported a shock first quarter loss.

"This share price is exaggerated," said one broker, adding that he thought that Estonian investors who had bought the shares recently at 2.50 lats each were trying to support the price around that level.
"It will be interesting to see how much longer they will be there," the broker said.
He said that once the Estonian efforts to support the price stopped, then it would probably fall to around 1.12 lats.
But Rietumu broker Dmitry Krutik said in his weekly market bulletin that Olainfarm was being looked on as a quality stock.

"It is obvious that we can already say that some market participants look on Olainfarm as an investment object and that this company is a good candidate to be a blue chip on the Latvian market," Krutik said in a statement.
Unibanka was second most active on 13,900 lats, losing 11 santimes to 3.22 lats.
